from.place: ## Proof, first sentence: the application of thm-sc-jacobian-representability to the proper curve C requires projectivity

title: A proper scheme of dimension at most one over a field is projective
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $X$ be a proper scheme over $k$ with topological Krull dimension $\dim X\leq1$ (with $\dim\varnothing=-\infty$; for nonempty $X$, the dimension is that of [def-pc-dimension]). Then there are an integer $N\geq0$ and a closed immersion $X\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^N_k$ over $k$; equivalently, $X$ is projective over $k$ ([def-pc-projective-morphism]).
